title: Data Center Planning Lead
description:
Meta is seeking a senior infrastructure planning leader to join Data Center Central Planning. In this role, you will develop integrated, multi‑year global data center capacity plans and scaling strategies that ensure Meta can deliver the right infrastructure at the right time, cost, and reliability, while staying adaptable under uncertainty. You’ll translate fast-evolving demand signals—especially those driven by AI large clusters—into executable supply strategies and clear executive decision points.This is a high-leverage role operating at the intersection of data center planning, demand forecasting, infrastructure engineering, supply strategy. * Own multi-year DC capacity planning and the Plan of Record (PoR): Develop, maintain, and continuously refresh integrated global data center supply/capacity plans
* drive monthly/quarterly updates to assumptions, constraints, and scenarios to ensure plans remain decision-grade and executable.
* Lead decision-quality tradeoffs for leadership: Apply quantitative and strategic judgment to build scenarios and evaluate alternatives
* present clear options, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations for multi‑billion‑dollar infrastructure investments and portfolio decisions.
* Drive AI large cluster planning outcomes: Partner with engineering and delivery stakeholders to incorporate AI-driven demand profiles, large-cluster requirements, and emerging constraints into the central plan
* help shape the capacity and delivery strategy to support rapid AI evolution.
* Create durable planning frameworks (beyond “spreadsheet planning”): Improve the planning ecosystem by defining requirements

description:
Frontier Power USA (FPUSA) is the industry’s first vertically integrated long-duration energy storage (LDES) developer and independent power producer (IPP), giving the company a unique position in the clean energy sector. FPUSA has direct OEM access from cell to software, enabling tight control over technology performance, reliability, and cost. This end-to-end integration supports innovative project development, streamlined operations, and scalable growth. * Translate project duty cycles, grid requirements, and operating objectives into power, energy, controls, and performance requirements.

* Define grid-following and grid-forming strategies, including ride-through, islanding, black start, voltage and frequency response, and coordination with other generation.

* Lead supplier requirements, design reviews, FAT, SAT, commissioning, performance testing, and resolution of cross-vendor issues.

* Own controls documentation, interface specifications, sequences of operation, alarm philosophy, cybersecurity requirements, and validation plans.

* Support safety and code compliance, including NFPA 855, UL 9540/9540A, emergency shutdown, hazard mitigation, and AHJ coordination.

* Build reusable standards, test libraries, and engineering practices for consistent deployment across multiple OEM combinations.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, controls engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.
